chunks: Let not those who are niggardly of things that God has given them of His largesse think that this is good for them. In fact, it is worse; for what they grudged will be hung around their necks on the Day of Resurrection. To God belong the heavens and the earth, and God is aware of all you do.

key_terms.سَيُطَوَّقُونَ: they will be hung around the necks
key_terms.يَبْخَلُونَ: to be stingy or hoard wealth

ai.seo_question: What happens to the wealth of those who are stingy and hoard it according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Khums* and voluntary charity (*Sadaqat*), emphasizing that hoarding wealth prevents spiritual purification and leads to divine retribution. The imagery of wealth becoming a 'yoke' around the neck signifies that the very assets withheld from circulation will serve as a heavy burden and witness against the owner on the Day of Judgment. This reinforces the Shia understanding of wealth as a trust (*amanah*) from Allah, requiring active distribution to maintain social equity and spiritual health.
